gloss: to command; to lead; to unify

definitions.gloss: to command; to lead; to direct (a group)
definitions.explanation: To exercise leadership and bring a group together under unified direction. Used for military command, team leadership, and organizational management.

examples.japanese: {将軍|しょうぐん}が{軍|ぐん}を{統率|とうそつ}した。
キャプテンとしてチームを{統率|とうそつ}する{力|ちから}がある。
examples.english: He has the ability to lead the team as captain.

examples.japanese: {部門|ぶもん}が{多|おお}いので、{全体|ぜんたい}を{統率|とうそつ}するのは{簡単|かんたん}ではない。
examples.english: There are many departments, so it's not easy to lead the whole organization.

notes:
USAGE:
Implies strong, authoritative leadership that brings people together under a common direction. More formal and powerful than {指導|しどう}する (to guide/instruct).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {統率力|とうそつりょく} (leadership ability)
- {統率|とうそつ}のとれた (well-organized, unified)
- {軍|ぐん}を{統率|とうそつ}する (to command an army)
- チームを{統率|とうそつ}する (to lead a team)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指揮|しき}する: to command — often used for military or musical direction
- {率|ひき}いる: to lead — more literary, used for leading troops or groups
